findings.claim: The MIGRATION section still ships the pre-fold claim that a totem spec free-text run 'can newly PROCEED where it used to refuse' on the negative-relevance path, contradicting line 26 of the same file and the shipped code.
findings.counterexample: A retrieval whose only hits carry relevance -0.5 returns refuse:true at the fold head (spec.test.ts it.each and allFaulted, both passing).

findings.claim: The evaluateGroundingFloor docblock still says it 'Mirrors the MCP tool's semantics' and that 'the floor fires only when a real relevance signal exists' - both now false.
findings.counterexample: One hit with relevance 2.0: the CLI refuses (faulted:1, nothingUsable), while search-knowledge.ts counts it as signal on a bare typeof, sets bestRelevance=2 above the floor, and returns it.

findings.claim: Both new refusal strings hard-code the l2-specific cause instead of leaving it to OUT_OF_RANGE_CAUSE for the running metric, re-introducing the defect class fold 2 removed from lance-search.ts.
findings.counterexample: Under dot, the slice's own measured probe returns _distance -1 -> relevance 1.5, a non-unit-norm embedder profile, which the refusal would report as 'a negative _distance under l2: an SDK or data fault'.

findings.claim: The new bestRelevance===null branch asserts 'nothing usable grounds this run' without the mmnto-ai/totem#2735 delivered-lessons disclosure the sibling 0-hit arm carries.
findings.counterexample: Three faulted specs beside 10 delivered lessons prints 'Found: 3 specs, 0 sessions, 0 code, 10 lessons' immediately above 'nothing usable grounds this run', the exact contradiction the #2735 rule cures.

findings.claim: The Greptile P2 decline's conclusion is correct (no doctrine or tenet requires warn-only runtime contracts to live in an ADR) but its cited receipt is misstated: the mmnto-ai/totem-strategy#722 round-1 row declines on the content's class, not by scoping the rule to the proposal class.
findings.counterexample: The scoping the decline needs is in totem-strategy proposals/accepted/301-authoring-discipline-scaffold.md line 77 ('a proposal names the gate; the ADR writes the contract'), which was not cited.

findings.claim: The all-faulted refusal discloses no candidate paths, narrowing the 'Exclusion is disclosed, never silently dropped' contract relative to main.
findings.counterexample: On main a hit with relevance -0.5 entered signal and was listed with its path; now withheld is [] and only a count is printed.

findings.claim: The accepted Object.freeze remedy is pinned by no assertion, so a refactor dropping it passes every gate.
findings.counterexample: Grep for isFrozen across packages/core/src/store and packages/cli/src returns zero hits.

findings.claim: The user-facing refusal contract still enumerates exactly two arms and omits the new all-faulted arm.
findings.counterexample: spec.ts adds nothingUsable as a third refusal condition that neither the sentence nor the page's rendered examples cover.

verdict: 1 BLOCKING, 4 MATERIAL, 3 MINOR over 66f26246 (the bot-round fold, pre-rebase); six folded in 9f0e2136 after the rebase onto b17e348b: the changeset migration line says REFUSE, the docblock stops claiming to mirror the MCP predicate, the refusal strings name the fault class and leave the cause to the search layer's warning, the all-faulted arm carries the delivered-lessons clause, the freeze is pinned, the CLI reference names the third arm. f5 re-grounded in the disposition (proposal 301 line 77); f6 declined - a fault is not a measurement and is never listed as one. The leg also established the fault arm is tighter than main on every row of the truth table, that no null/string relevance producer exists, and that the tests discriminate the pre-fold code. A final narrow leg reads 9f0e2136.
